4. Read each register using read_reg(addr)

Test_Description: Verify write and read-back of all 49 GPIO GP0 registers using 6 different data patterns: 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555, 0xF5F5F5F5, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xFFFF0000. Applies write_mask before writing and read_mask before reading.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; Default value check (TC_GPIO_001) completed
Test_Steps:
1. For each of 6 test patterns (chk_val[]):
   a. Iterate through all 49 register addresses
   b. Skip registers flagged in skip_array[] (indices 32,37-44 skipped)
   c. Skip registers with write_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000
   d. Write (data_wr & write_mask_array[i]) to register using write_reg(addr, data)
   e. Iterate again to read back each register
   f. Skip non-writable and non-readable registers
   g. Read register and apply read_mask: data_rd = read_reg(addr) & read_mask_array[i]
   h. Compute expected: exp_val = (data_wr & read_mask & write_mask) | (~write_mask & read_mask & default_value)
   i. Compare data_rd with exp_val
Expected_Results: For all 6 data patterns and all writable/readable registers: read-back value matches computed expected value. wr_fail_cnt == 0.

Test_Description: Verify GPIO level-triggered interrupt generation in active-high mode for all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 to GPIO_39). Programs each GPIO in input mode with level interrupt enabled (level_sel=1) and verifies interrupt raw status, group interrupt status, interrupt clearing, and sysreg interrupt flow.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; GIC IRQ 87 (GPIO0) or 88 (GPIO1) enabled; SYSREG interrupt enabled via MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1
Test_Steps:
For each GPIO pin i (0 to 31):
1. Write 0x00180000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4) => Sets io_ctrl=1 (input mode, bit[20]), level_sel=1 (bit[19]), nedge_intr_en=1 (bit[18])
2. Wait 50 cycles
3. Write (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 (offset 0x84) to enable group interrupt for pin i
4. Wait 10 cycles
5. Write 0xFFFFFFFF to SRAM location 0xA0243FFC (stimulus to drive pin high)
6. Set int_pend=1 and wait for interrupt (polling loop)
7. In ISR (Default_IRQHandler):
   a. Read GPIO register: rdata = read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4)
   b. Check (rdata & 0x2) != 0 => intr_raw_sts bit[1] is set
   c. Read group status: rdata_grp = read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1) (offset 0x88)
   d. Check (rdata_grp & (1<<i)) != 0 => group interrupt raised
   e. Clear interrupt: write 0x00110000 to GPIO register (intr_clr=1 at bit[16])
   f. Wait 20 cycles
   g. Read GPIO register again, verify rdata == 0x100001
   h. Disable group interrupt: write 0x00000000 to INTR1_INTR_EN1
   i. Read group status again, verify == 0x0
   j. Clear sysreg status via MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1
   k. Verify sysreg status cleared
   l. Clear GIC IRQ
Expected_Results:
For each of 32 GPIO pins:
- intr_raw_sts (bit[1]) is set when level-1 detected on pin in input mode
- Group interrupt status (INTR1_INTR_STS1) shows correct bit set
- After clearing: GPIO register reads 0x100001 (io_ctrl=1, data_in=1)
- Group interrupt status clears to 0x0
- Sysreg interrupt status clears successfully
- test_err == 0
Registers_Accessed: gp0_gpio_8 to gp0_gpio_39, gp0_intr1_intr_en1, gp0_intr1_intr_sts1, MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1
Register_Fields: data_in[0](RO), intr_raw_sts[1](RO), intr_clr[16](WO), pedge_intr_en[17](RW), nedge_intr_en[18](RW), level_sel[19](RW), io_ctrl[20](RW2); G8_intr_en to G39_intr_en[0-31](RW); G8_intr_sts to G39_intr_sts[0-31](RO)
Pass_Fail_Criteria: test_err == 0: All 32 GPIO pins generate level-high interrupt correctly, group status matches, interrupt clears properly, sysreg clears. finish(0) on success.
Notes: Active-high level interrupt: level_sel=1 (bit[19]=1). Write value 0x00180000 sets bits[19:18]=11 (level_sel=1, nedge_intr_en=1) but primary test is level interrupt. GIC IRQ 87 for GPIO0, 88 for GPIO1. Conditional compilation via #ifdef GPIO0/#ifdef GPIO1.

Test_Description: Verify GPIO level-triggered interrupt generation in active-low mode for all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 to GPIO_39). Programs each GPIO in input mode with level interrupt enabled (level_sel=0) and verifies interrupt raw status, group interrupt status, interrupt clearing, and sysreg interrupt flow.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; GIC IRQ 87 (GPIO0) or 88 (GPIO1) enabled; SYSREG interrupt enabled; Active-high test (TC_GPIO_003) completed
Test_Steps:
For each GPIO pin i (0 to 31):
1. Write 0x00100000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4) => Sets io_ctrl=1 (input mode, bit[20]), level_sel=0 (bit[19]=0)
2. Wait 50 cycles
3. Write (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 (offset 0x84) to enable group interrupt for pin i
4. Wait 10 cycles
5. Write ~(1<<i) to SRAM location 0xA0243FFC (stimulus to drive pin low for target GPIO)
6. Set int_pend=1 and wait for interrupt (polling loop)
7. In ISR (Default_IRQHandler): Same verification as TC_GPIO_003
   a-l. (Same ISR steps as active-high test)
Expected_Results:
For each of 32 GPIO pins:
- intr_raw_sts (bit[1]) is set when level-0 detected on pin in input mode with level_sel=0
- Group interrupt status shows correct bit set
- Interrupt clears properly (GPIO register reads expected value after clear)
- Group interrupt status clears to 0x0
- Sysreg interrupt status clears successfully
- test_err == 0
Registers_Accessed: gp0_gpio_8 to gp0_gpio_39, gp0_intr1_intr_en1, gp0_intr1_intr_sts1, MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1
Register_Fields: data_in[0](RO), intr_raw_sts[1](RO), intr_clr[16](WO), pedge_intr_en[17](RW), nedge_intr_en[18](RW), level_sel[19](RW), io_ctrl[20](RW2); G8_intr_en to G39_intr_en[0-31](RW); G8_intr_sts to G39_intr_sts[0-31](RO)
Pass_Fail_Criteria: test_err == 0: All 32 GPIO pins generate level-low interrupt correctly, group status matches, interrupt clears properly, sysreg clears. finish(0) on success.
Notes: Active-low level interrupt: level_sel=0 (bit[19]=0). Write value 0x00100000 sets only io_ctrl=1 (input mode). Stimulus is inverted: ~(1<<i) drives target pin low. Same ISR handler shared with active-high test. GIC IRQ 87 for GPIO0, 88 for GPIO1.
